title: Extra bone Variants!
description: a mod that makes the skeleton variants drop unique bones, craftable to unique variants of bonemeal and bone blocks!
body:
A mod that gives the Bogged, Stray, and Wither Skeleton there own unqie bone variants, with custom bonemeal uses, and bone blocks. 

Wither Bone Meal removes plants where you right click

Bogged Bone Meal makes mushrooms grow and always makes super mushrooms grow

Stray Bone Meal makes grass into snowy grass, and water into ice, then ice to packed ice, then packed ice to blue ice

Tested for neoforge 21.1.15 and 21.4.78-beta
